The '''first Count''' of the wealthy '''House Malreaux''' had been a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] that operated in the [[Bay of Tears]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. He extorted a grant of nobility for his [[House Malreaux|house]] from the nobles of the surrounding territory in an exchange for a loose promise to not plunder their ships in the bay.
